What's New in Version 3.8.3

  • Internal cleanup release: reorganized the dictation state machine into smaller, focused pieces (recorder UI, model loading, live transcription) so future fixes land more reliably.
  • Added congestion probes and performance markers around the recording path to help diagnose memory-pressure lag in the field.

What's New in Version 3.8.2

  • Tap anywhere on the recorder pill to edit the live transcript — no more hunting for the exact text glyph.
  • Inline edit now expands into a proper rounded-rect card that grows with your content, so longer edits feel like editing in a real text field rather than fighting a tiny capsule.
  • Snappier stop: removed a 50ms quiesce delay so the recorder closes the moment you release the hotkey.
  • Smoother UI under load thanks to tighter MainActor isolation in the recorder state machine.
  • Acknowledgments moved from Settings to the Help menu, where third-party credits actually belong.

What's New in Version 3.8.1

  • You can now edit the live realtime transcript inline — fix typos or polish phrasing without waiting for the recording to finish.
  • Better realtime transcription quality through improved voice-activity detection and segment handling, so utterance boundaries land where they should.
  • Added always-on recorder performance signposts (subsystem com.yangzichao.hoah, category RecorderPerf) to help diagnose hotkey-to-mic-start lag under memory pressure.

What's New in Version 3.8.0

  • Added Apple Speech as a native dictation option, including realtime transcription and locale resolution shared with batch transcription.
  • Added NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 as a new on-device dictation model with both streaming and batch modes.
  • Improved cold-start dictation: HoAh now captures audio first while local models wake up, then drains and finalizes more reliably.
  • Added idle-unload management for local transcription models so large models can be released after inactivity.
  • Improved local model setup with recommendation badges, clearer model descriptions, and an hf-mirror.com fallback for Qwen3 downloads.
  • Cleaned up dictation providers by removing OpenAI dictation support and focusing transcription choices on Apple Speech and on-device models.
  • Refined recorder state feedback with a processing visualizer and final status updates, plus cleaner AI Action menus and shortcuts.

What's New in Version 3.7.9

  • Realtime dictation feels closer to live now: fixed an audio buffering policy that was causing the transcript to lag behind your voice.
  • No more stuck "preparing" states — if the recorder can't start within a short window (e.g. after switching mics mid-session), it now bails out cleanly instead of hanging the pill.
  • Switching input devices in the middle of a recording is more reliable: HoAh detects the change and recovers instead of getting stuck on the old device.
  • Smoother streaming with the local Qwen3 models thanks to cached audio conversion and tighter buffer management — less CPU churn during long sessions.
  • Quieter UI updates from local model progress (throttled), and a small reliability fix so transcript auto-cleanup no longer registers duplicate observers when toggled.

What's New in Version 3.7.8

  • Faster dictation start: the audio engine is now reused across recordings, so the pill comes up snappier when you tap the shortcut.
  • Smoother handling when you switch input devices (AirPods, USB mic, etc.) mid-session — the audio session is reconfigured for the new device instead of getting stuck on the old one.
  • Better stability under memory pressure: HoAh now watches system memory and trims caches before macOS forces a kill, especially during long Qwen3 dictation sessions.
  • Clearer model descriptions in English and Chinese, focused on when to pick each option.
  • More helpful errors when your AI provider or API key is misconfigured, so problems surface up front instead of silently mid-enhancement.

What's New in Version 3.7.7

  • Added Qwen3-ASR (0.6B and 1.7B) as a new on-device dictation option, with both streaming and batch modes you can pick from in Settings.
  • Reworked local model management: a new Local Models store with download, warmup, and transcription progress states, plus clearer model cards during onboarding.
  • Replaced the standard progress view with an animated progress bar that shimmers during long downloads and warmups, and hid the bar during warmup-only phases.
  • Added a startup verification step that checks your AI provider and transcription model on launch and surfaces actionable errors instead of failing silently mid-dictation.
  • Tidied the model catalog: removed retired Whisper base / large-v3 entries, renamed models for clarity (Whisper Large v3 Turbo, Scribe v2 Streaming), and switched downloads to the shared HuggingFace Hub cache.
  • Improved reliability: better recovery from incomplete model downloads, refreshed audio session handling for the current input device, and cleaner cancel and retry flows in the model UI.

What's New in Version 3.7.6

  • Added longer transcript retention options (90 days, 180 days, and 1 year) so you can keep history around as long as you need.
  • Real-time transcription pill now auto-grows with the transcript text for better readability while dictating.
  • Allowed custom model IDs across all AI providers and added a feedback form in Help for sending issues directly via mail.
  • Replaced the cursor paster with a new PasteFlow that produces cleaner paste behavior, avoids trailing spaces, and prevents stuck Cmd keys.
  • Improved recording reliability with memory pressure monitoring, audio session updates for the current device, and recovery from stuck multi-press shortcuts.
  • Clarified shortcut and language-switch instructions in Settings.

What's New in Version 3.7.5

  • Changed AutoSend to a dedicated double-press of the right Option key, so the gesture stays consistent even if you customize the main recording shortcut.
  • Restored Append as a separate optional recording shortcut and now copy the appended result back to the clipboard while showing the combined text in history.
  • Updated recorder badges, advanced trigger copy, and localizations so AutoSend and Append are labeled more clearly throughout the app.

What's New in Version 3.7.4

  • Added per-slot enable controls for Selection Action shortcuts so you can keep only the shortcuts you want active.
  • Refreshed the Selection Action shortcut editor with clearer enabled and disabled states plus a denser card-based layout.
  • Updated shortcut summaries and localizations so settings and keyboard shortcut references better match the active Selection Action slots.

What's New in Version 3.7.3

  • Updated Selection Action shortcuts to scale automatically with your active AI Actions, so the available shortcut range stays aligned with the actions you can actually run.
  • Improved the shortcuts reference and settings UI to show the active Selection Action shortcut range more clearly.
  • Refined settings copy and localizations around AI Action shortcuts for clearer guidance.

What's New in Version 3.7.2

  • Updated Selection AI Actions to copy the current selection automatically instead of depending on whatever was already in the clipboard.
  • Improved Selection AI Action notifications and awaited paste cleanup so progress stays visible until completion and dismisses cleanly afterward.
  • Fixed settings and AI runtime state issues while refining recorder visualizer motion controls for a more stable experience.

What's New in Version 3.7.1

  • Added a collapsible Clipboard Action configuration panel so the settings UI stays compact until you need detailed shortcut controls.
  • Improved shutdown handling around local Whisper warmup and Metal resource cleanup to reduce exit-time crashes.
  • Cleaned up theme selection so unsupported themes no longer appear and default theme application is more consistent.

What's New in Version 3.7.0

  • Added Azure OpenAI support with deployment-aware configuration and automatic endpoint normalization.
  • Added OCI Generative AI support with region-aware setup, expanded OCI region coverage, and OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
  • Improved provider setup guidance, recording audio muting reliability, and clipboard AI action shortcut handling.

What's New in Version 3.6.9

  • Bug fixes and stability improvements.

What's New in Version 3.6.8

  • Updated Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, GROQ, and Cerebras model recommendations to match current APIs and remove outdated defaults.
  • Reordered provider defaults to prefer faster low-latency models for everyday AI enhancement tasks.
  • Improved provider validation and dynamic model discovery so OpenRouter and Cerebras show models your API key can actually use.

What's New in Version 3.6.7

  • Fixed the onboarding model download flow so tapping another model during an active download no longer leaves downloads stuck.
  • Improved onboarding download state handling to keep progress indicators and actions in sync.

What's New in Version 3.6.6

  • Added Ollama support for local AI models (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Phi) with custom endpoint configuration.

What's New in Version 3.6.5

  • Bug fixes and stability improvements.

What's New in Version 3.6.4

  • Fixed global hotkey updates so custom shortcut changes take effect immediately.
  • Eliminated duplicate shortcut handler registration when reopening the recorder panel repeatedly.
  • Improved custom hotkey setup UX in menu bar and setup flows to reduce misconfiguration.

What's New in Version 3.6.3

  • Expanded Doubao model selection to include Seed Flash and DeepSeek V3.2 options.
  • Improved local Whisper model download fallback behavior for China-accessible sources.
  • Restored request retry behavior for Doubao enhancement requests to improve reliability.

Improvements

  • Theme System: Complete refactor of the Mini Recorder's visualization engine to be fully theme-driven, allowing for distinct shapes, sizes, and behaviors per theme.
  • Deterministic Visuals: Visualizer randomness is now seeded for consistent aesthetic behavior across sessions.

New Features

  • 🐶 Dog: DoggoLingo (EN) / 汪语 (ZH) / ワン語 (JP)
  • 🐦 Bird: Birb language (EN) / 鸟语 (ZH) / 鳥語 (JP)
  • 🐰 Bunny: Soft shy bunny style
  • Social Media Styles: ✨ 小红书风 (Xiaohongshu), 🎀 软妹风 (Soft Girl), 🎭 中二病 (Chuunibyou)

Improvements

  • Most Recently Used: Translation targets now automatically move to the front of the list when used.
  • Centralized State Management: Translation language settings are now properly synchronized across all views.
  • Collapsible Settings: Auto export settings now use a compact collapsible design.

HoAh Dictation v3.4.7

New Features

  • Improved Localization: Refined Chinese and English translations for export features.

Improvements

  • CSV Export: The option to export as a single CSV file is now clearly labeled.
  • Release Pipeline: Migrated to a new secure release infrastructure for better stability.
